_experiment.description: Training seed variance — seed=1. Identical to baseline (seed=0) in all other settings. Run alongside e10_seed_2, e10_seed_3, e10_seed_4 and the baseline (seed=0) to obtain 5 independent sparsity curves. Plot mean +/- std across seeds to establish whether results are statistically stable. High variance across seeds would undermine the reliability of all single-run results reported in the thesis. The sparsification omega is also re-sampled per run (numpy random state differs), so this measures end-to-end variance.
literature: Blalock et al. 2020 (survey): highlights that many pruning results in the literature are single-run and lack variance estimates — this experiment addresses that gap for the thesis results
